core_obligations: The author develops a width-independent multiplicative-weight implementation for fractional forest packing, with greedy-forest minimum-ratio oracle, dynamic minimum-spanning-tree maintenance and lazy weight updates that amortize to deterministic near-linear time. These data structures and approximation/iteration analyses yield O(m log^3 n / epsilon^2) approximation of the k-cut relaxation. The rounded (2+epsilon) cut is retained as an application and not a second count.
